text_block_list.text: A few weeks before the Nippon Derby.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer.
We currently have two key cards in our hand.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The first card is the "Japanese Derby."
The second is the "Kikka-sho."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Normally you'd keep both, but
this second Kikuka Sho is—"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—Discard.
Mind if I throw it out?
choice_data_list: Are you going to give up on the Kikuka Sho?
Are you throwing away the Kikuka Sho?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, even with every strategy at our disposal,
the gap is still wide. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: The only way to close that gap is by specializing entirely for the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Aiming for the entire Triple Crown when starting as a tiny border nation was just way too much of an impossible game.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I've already abandoned any ambition for the Satsuki Sho.
If I give up on the Kikuka Sho as well—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"The Japanese Derby... Even with my resources, maybe we can pull it off.
So—please let me stake it all on that one shot."

A hyper-specialized training deck.
Dedicate all training time
to preparing for the Japanese Derby—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The greatest Derby in history...!
And the one to put on the best performance there is—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's meeeeeeeee!
Yeeeeeeaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
*Haa, fuu*... Somehow... I managed to get ready.
Now all that's left is――

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I have only to engrave it.
A divine game record, into the history of the Japanese Derby."
And on the day of the event—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: An explosion of cheers—it feels like it could scorch the very heavens!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The greatest Derby in history.
Who will conquer this fierce battle and emerge victorious?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you today.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
For the future of the Clan of Roses,
I cannot afford to lose this race.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I want you to bear witness to my gallant figure as well,
Rulership.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there... Rose, you sure seem conscious
of me every now and then...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: (Did I mess something up? I'm pretty sure I haven't done anything to draw aggro from any specific players, though.)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: "Flash-san, it seems you aren't considered much of a favorite today, but..."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: What are you aiming for in this game?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...I want to dedicate this victory
to my beloved parents in Germany.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Heh, is that so...? Come to think of it, you do hail from Germany, the land of board games.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: By the way, Flash-san, did you know?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: In board games, there's basically no such thing as an unbeatable trump card.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Always... the strongest?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Yes. The strongest card in one situation might be completely useless in another.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
In other words, when it comes to board games,
the most important thing is—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—“Environment.” Those who control the field
control everything. Conversely, those who cannot—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
You'll just end up defeated
with a hand full of strong cards left to play.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... Today, I shall make them dance.
Flash-san, Rose, and Pisa too.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Right in the palm of my hand, the master of the board!
(Oooooo!)

The venue erupts in a stir. Rulership's boldness
was half genuine, half act.
Indeed—

The more closely Rulership is marked,
the easier it is to control the pace.

A... Amazing!
So cool...!!

"While the horse girl watching beside me
was also caught up in the excitement..."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(As expected, not a single person has noticed.
However—I can see it.)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Flash-san's hidden trump card.
The decisive finishing blow. But...)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(That one move to decide the game—
I won't let you make it.)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Bring it on, Flash!
I'll take you down with my strategy!)
